title: valeriana muelleri
intro: Valeriana muelleri, commonly known as the New Zealand valerian, is a species of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, particularly for its sedative and calming effects. The health benefits of Valeriana muelleri include reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation and sleep, and alleviating symptoms of insomnia and restlessness. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including valepotriates, valerenic acid, and isovalerenic acid, which interact with the GABA receptor in the brain to produce a calming effect.
